answer: A scripted farm thus has to pad 284 submissions and hold each member open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. Because the timing is recorded against the wander challenge, the beacon audit can replay the raven history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 92 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
